newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian farm output to shrink five pct in '97.
newsitem.headline: Russian farm output to shrink five pct in '97.

text.p: Total Russian agricultural output will contract by five percent this year, not two percent as originally forecast, according to new government figures obtained by Reuters on Tuesday.
The figures, presented to the State Duma, the lower house of parliament, by First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais, gave no breakdown for individual agricultural sectors.
Russian farm output declined by seven percent in 1996 after an eight percent drop in 1995.
The government has forecast this year's net grain harvest at 70 million tonnes, barely above 69.3 million tonnes in 1996. Last year's harvest was the second worst on record in three decades.
